verdict.rationale: Skills ship as plain SKILL.md markdown files in a public folder tree (skills/engineering/tdd/SKILL.md and others). The installer writes them into your repo as ordinary editable files you own, and the product claims to work across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and Copilot, with Codex and Copilot plugin routes documented. A hands-on probe confirmed a `--copy` install dropping a readable SKILL.md with clean frontmatter into ./.claude/skills/tdd/. Missing for 10: hands-on corroboration of carrying the same files into a non-Claude harness (the probe only exercised Claude Code), and any format spec beyond the frontmatter seen in practice.
